opening.argument: The material is plainly structured as news coverage of Prime Minister Narendra Modi reaching Lahore: the title identifies the event, while the broadcast states that Air India One landed there and shows the aircraft at the airport with an arrival lower-third. It then reports that both leaders met and places the visit in the context of Nawaz Sharif's birthday, presenting the encounter and its possible significance for bilateral relations. Nothing described offers money, requests payment or credentials, or sets out a deceptive way to participate. Sparse frame sampling limits conclusions about portions not observed, but the presented material supports ordinary news reporting.
